quote_text:
You must be absolutely delighted  with that performance. Is that  
the best Aberdeen have played  for some considerable time? 
I have a really bad memory actually. I can't back  too long. But it was a good performance today.
So— no, but the most important for me is like— I think the quality inside the squad is growing. 
We have a healthy competition inside. We have some players out because  
of injuries the whole season, and now it's coming some more,  
but still we can perform as a team. And that says about the squad— has to be strong.
And also see how more and more players  take responsibility for result. 
We know some qualities of some players,  but also now how they manage the games 
and keep the balance of the team— do  a little bit extra they need to do 
with the qualities in the  right moment of the game.
So I was really happy for the team and the players and also how we respond on the— we start  
the game really well and then they score  
more or less the first time they arrive. But the reaction was really strong and good. 
No stress, we do the things we want to  do and try again and believe in the team.
You were demanding more kind of energy at  the top end of the pitch. You certainly got  
that today, didn’t you? Yeah, I think like— 
when we have this window— players in and out— 
and identity is in the future for us there,  we want to grow every week to be clear. 
Today we talked about it before  in the press, before the game, 
and I think we could show our  supporters today what we want to be.
And the pressing and the  transitions, and the aggressivity 
when we arrive to the box—  I like what I see today.
But also again we talk about before the game, at playing at home at  
Pittodrie with the supporters, this was a sellout and they keep pushing the team. 
And that togetherness— it’s so important for now but also in the future to grow  
as a club and grow as a team and be competitive in the long term.
You must be delighted for Nisbet as well— a double  today, really good performance. He’s worked so  
hard to get to the sharpness that he's at now. Yeah, we talk about his goals,  
and of course that's important, but you see how he takes responsibility.
I've talked about before—  like winning the ball back, 
he’s helping the defence,  he’s pressing from behind 
and creating transitions for us but  still arriving in the scoring chances.
That’s how he has grown as a player this season. I think it’s the best part as a— when you work as  
a— close players and see them grow and also get the result for them,  
the individual part inside the game, and can help the team in that way.
Leon said he preferred Kevin's goal.  What goal did you think was the best? 
I don’t know. I actually  haven’t seen the goals yet, 
but I have some picture in my head. But I like all the goals we score.
Kevin a player you'd like to  have around here next season? 
Yeah again, it’s not our player. 
He's here right now, so it’s not  for me to say that kind of thing. 
But if we like Kevin— yes, we do. But that's what I can say.
Be very hard to for Kevin… 
Finances again, like we focus  on the moment right now.
Thank you so much. Very testing in terms  
of— that’s the top six. You would be obviously—  you want far more than that from this season? 
Yeah from the beginning we have a  clear picture for the long term. 
But this season we want to arrive to Europe. I think it’s important for us.
And we will try till the last game,  both in the cup and in the league. 
So nothing has changed what we're pushing for. 
And we try to keep growing as a  team to deserve it in the end. 
So I’m happy with the performance  today, and then now next— 
now we have to focus on the next game away  against Ross County and put all energy on that.
Shinnie looked impressive at left-back.  How pleased are you with how he did there? 
No, that’s what I said— like, we have  a healthy competition inside the squad,  
and we need it because this season is long.
And I also have to say— Motherwell played well. I think it was a good game to watch today— 
what you think about before the  game, transitions, a quite open game.
But sometimes you need different  qualities, and I think Shinnie  
did really well again as a left-back, 
and helped us in the build-up and  a lot of other good things also.
So even Clarkson— how he— we  know his qualities in attacking, 
but how he balanced the team today and took  responsibilities to not get too exposed— 
it was nice to see his responsibility also.
Sorry, manager— Andy Halliday felt that Papley  should have been sent off for the challenge today. 
Do you have a view of it? No, I haven’t seen it yet, no. 
But I never think about situations. I trust the referee in good times and bad times. 
But the referee was close, they  have the VAR, and he get the yellow.
Good to see Ester back? Yeah, I think like— 
I think Motherwell in that period  get some more rhythm in the build-up 
and Ester is a really good  pressing player and he helps us 
to turn the game to our profit again  with his pressing and intensity 
and cleverness how to cut in passing lines. 
So it’s good to have him back and  have these choices inside the games.
Strong performance from Alfie Bavidge as  well. Do you feel he’s progressed in the  
months he's been here? Yeah, I think always— 
it’s always when new players arrive,  everybody want it to happen quick. 
But it’s a new environment for him. It’s a new context, a new teammates,  
a different kind of how we play probably, and even how we train.
And I think he adapting really well  and taking again the responsibility 
and adaptation to the league, our style. 
And he was— have been really,  really good now in the last games.
You see him get his first goal? Yeah, it was nice. It’s super nice,  
and I hope he's happy also and enjoy the night.
title: Jimmy Thelin FULL Post Match Press Conference | Aberdeen 4-1 Motherwell
